name: S Dnyom Rozhdeniya!
source:
The protagonist, Andrey, is waiting in his apartment for guests and the opportunity to celebrate the holiday! Today is an important day, and your three female friends, Polina, Veronika, and Tanya, will definitely help you spend it right without making any mistakes. But they're still not here, and you keep waiting... and then, it finally happens, the long-awaited knock on the door! The girls have arrived!

So which of the girls will become your chosen one? Who will get all your attention? Will you be able to pass all their tests? And who will get the last piece of cake?!

[Translated from [url=https://vk.com/topic-168869241_38532416]VK[/url]]
translation:
主角安德烈正在他的公寓里等待客人和庆祝节日的机会！今天是一个重要的日子，你的三位女性朋友波琳娜、维罗妮卡和坦尼娅一定会帮助你正确度过这一天，不犯任何错误。但他们仍然不在这里，你继续等待……然后，终于发生了，期待已久的敲门声！姑娘们来了！

那么哪一位女孩会成为你的选择呢？谁会吸引你所有的注意力？你能通过他们的所有测试吗？而最后一块蛋糕又会归谁呢？！

[翻译自[url=https://vk.com/topic-168869241_38532416]VK[/url]]
